subject: Re: AndroidControl status: unseen-app gap is large
body:
Freya, Alina,

Escalating this one rather than quietly absorbing it. The 61% -> 34% unseen-app gap is a product blocker for device control, and I'd rather Hana hears it from us in the May 18 readout with a plan attached than in a launch review later.

Decisions: the structural accessibility-tree representation becomes the Q3 proposal — Ondrej writes a one-pager by May 15 with an estimated headcount. We do not re-tune on seen apps in the meantime; it would only move the number we don't care about.

Freya, please include both instruction granularities in the readout. The 22% high-level number is the honest one.

Ulla
